title: Enable Mintlify partial authentication for audience separation
description: Provider activation blocker and staged rollout: (1) enable organization authentication on PR previews first; (2) verify anonymous public routes, authenticated kombify-team routes, and public-only llms.txt/MCP/search on previews; (3) before any merge/live activation, ship or establish a public-marker-only baseline (or an equivalent verified atomic provider rollout), because current main lacks explicit public markers; (4) only after that evidence, enable production Mintlify partial authentication; (5) admit restricted content and re-verify anonymous and authenticated behavior. Exact dashboard steps: enable Mintlify Authentication/partial auth for docs.kombify.io, authorize the required team users/group for kombify-team, enable organization authentication on PR previews, and verify both views. Do not store credentials here or mutate provider settings from the repository.
